{{Top|leg}}
The '''''Unsung''''' was a modified [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rapid Response Task Force]].<ref name="Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], it took part in the [[Battle of Mindor]]. The ''Unsung'' was destroyed by a near miss from the [[gravity gun]], still powerful enough to rip the ship apart.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" />
